evidence: /products lists 9 products; each card shows name, category badge (Tech/Home/Fitness), price, star rating + numeric value, brief description, image, and a "Buy Now" link to external URL.

Sort: Newest (default), Top Rated (4.9→4.4 order), Price Low→High ($199→$2,495), Price High→Low ($2,495→$199) all reorder correctly. Min rating "4.5+ stars" → 9→8 products (excludes 4.4 Philips). Price Range slider dragged to $1250 → 5 products all ≤$749.
Sort changes, rating filter and price slider each updated card order/set and the "N products found" counter instantly with no page reload (URL unchanged, no navigation).

With minRating 4.5 + price ≤$1250 + tags [wireless, coffee] selected → 2 results (Sony $399/4.8 has wireless, Breville $699/4.5 has coffee): OR across tags, AND across criteria. Adding search "sony" narrowed to exactly 1 result satisfying every active criterion.

"SONY" → 1 product found (name match); "NOISE CANCELLATION" → 1 (Sony, brief-description match); "Smart-Home" → 2 (Philips Hue, Dyson — tag match). All case-insensitive with accurate counts and only matching cards shown.

/products category select: Home Goods → 3 products (Breville, Philips Hue, Dyson); Fitness → 3 (Bowflex, Theragun, Peloton); Tech Gadgets → 3 (Samsung, MacBook, Sony). Count text updates to "3 products found" each time.
Switching the category dropdown between All/Home Goods/Fitness/Tech Gadgets updates both the trigger label (active category) and the rendered product set immediately.

Buy Now anchors carry the product's own affiliate URL with target=_blank rel=noopener (e.g. sony→https://example.com/sony-xm5, macbook→/macbook-pro, s24→/s24-ultra). Clicking Sony's Buy Now opened a new tab at https://example.com/sony-xm5.

Clicking Sony card image on /products opened /product/sony-wh-1000xm5 (h1 "Sony WH-1000XM5"); clicking the MacBook card name opened /product/macbook-pro-14 (h1 Apple MacBook Pro 14"). Both matched the clicked product.

Sony: homepage/featured, Tech category page, /products list and detail all show Tech, $399, 4.8, "Industry-leading noise cancellation…". MacBook: Tech/$1,999/4.9 consistent between list and detail. Detail pages show full multi-sentence review and all 5 spec rows with no ellipsis/truncation.

Detail pages checked for all 9 seeded products (Sony, MacBook, Samsung, Dyson, Philips, Breville, Peloton, Theragun, Bowflex): each shows name, category badge, numeric+star rating, price, brief description, 4 tags, 5 key specifications, hero image, full "My Review" and a Buy Now link to its own retailer URL, all matching list values.

Tags are topically relevant (Sony: headphones/wireless/noise-cancelling/premium; Dyson: vacuum/cordless/smart-home/cleaning; Peloton: cardio/cycling/smart-equipment/subscription; Breville: coffee/espresso/kitchen/appliance) and categories match product type. Values identical between card and detail views.

/product/does-not-exist-123 → "Product Not Found … doesn't exist or has been removed" with Browse All Products link and 0 product cards. /category/bogus → "Category Not Found" with 0 product cards. No unrelated product data shown.

issue: Missing publish validation: incomplete products and negative prices can be saved
actual: Only Name, Category and Short Description are validated ("Please fill in all required fields" on empty submit). Created "QA Incomplete Widget" with empty Full Review, empty Image URL, empty Affiliate Link and zero specifications — it was accepted ("Product created successfully") and now appears in admin/browse. Editing it to Price = -50 also saved and the card renders "-$50". Only the rating field is constrained (native min=0/max=5 blocks 9).

evidence: Create form's Category select offers exactly Tech Gadgets / Home Goods / Fitness (single-select). Created "QA Aeris Air Purifier" with Home Goods → appears on /category/home (4 products) and admin card shows single "Home" badge.

All 9 seeded products plus the newly created one show exactly one category badge (Tech/Home/Fitness); category pages partition them 3/3/3 (4 for Home after the new product). Admin category field is a single-select limited to the 3 supported categories with no "other"/empty option.

Created product with Tags field "qatestair, purifier" → detail page /product/qa-aeris-air-purifier shows both tag chips; searching "QATestAir" on /products returns exactly that product (1 product found).

issue: Tag-filter choices are static and ignore newly assigned tags
actual: After editing Theragun Pro's tags to "recovery, massagegun, qanewtag" (and creating a product tagged "qatestair, purifier"), the /products Filters tag list still shows only the original seed tags — qanewtag, massagegun, qatestair and purifier are absent, so the new tag cannot be selected as a filter. The list also still offers removed tags (muscle, therapy, massage); selecting "muscle" yields "0 products found".

evidence: Edited Theragun Pro tags from "recovery, massage, muscle, therapy" to "recovery, massagegun, qanewtag" (add + rename + remove). Detail page now shows exactly recovery/massagegun/qanewtag, and keyword search for "massagegun" returns the product (1 product found).

issue: Featured collection cannot be browsed in full; "View all" featured link ignores the featured filter
actual: Toggling featured does update the homepage strip (unfeaturing Dyson removed it and newly featured "QA Aeris Air Purifier Pro" took its slot), but the strip is capped at 3 items, so with 4 featured products one is hidden. The section's "View all" link goes to /products?featured=true, which renders "10 products found" — the entire catalogue including non-featured items — and the products page offers no featured-only filter, so the complete featured set is never browsable.

evidence: Created "QA Aeris Air Purifier" (Home Goods, $249, 4.2, image, affiliate link, tags, spec) — instantly visible on /category/home and its detail page. Edited it (name→…Pro, category→Tech Gadgets, $279, 4.8, new brief/full review, new image URL, new affiliate link, spec value change + added "Filter Life", featured on) and edited Theragun Pro's tags; all changes appeared immediately in admin list, homepage, category counts (Tech 4), list cards and detail page /product/qa-aeris-air-purifier-pro.

issue: No persistence — all admin changes are lost on page reload
actual: After reloading, /product/qa-aeris-air-purifier-pro shows "Product Not Found" and /products is back to "9 products found" (the created product is gone). The Theragun Pro tag edit reverted to the seeded "recovery, massage, muscle, therapy", and the unfeatured Dyson is featured again. localStorage and sessionStorage are both empty — state is held only in memory.
